QuestInfo.name: Meeting Evan
QuestInfo.0: You came all the way to Turtle Island to see Afrien, but someone is in your way. There must be some sort of misunderstanding. Talk to him.\r\n\r\n#rTip: You can get to Turtle Island through Olaf at Lith Harbor.
QuestInfo.1: Evan says that Afrien isn't well. He is in a deep sleep, so he is unable to talk. Evan smiles with his eyes... He reminds you of Freud.
QuestInfo.2: You came looking for Afrien, but met Evan instead. There's something familiar about him, something that soothes your pained heart, even just a little.

1.0: I'm sorry you came all the way here for nothing... The least I can do is send you back to the #rSix Path Crossway#k. I have that power, at least! \r\n#r(You will be moved to the map immediately. Press ESC if you do not want to be moved.)#k
